call: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<scratch>/.pi/jhon pi --print --no-session, on the directory the renderer wrote (plain pi with pi-claude-bridge@0.9.3, pi-web-access@0.43.0, and runtimes/pi/jhon.ts), in a scratch git repository with one commit and an uncommitted change to a.txt. The main session launched agents/review-risk.md, and in later runs agents/worker.md and agents/explore.md, by name with the subagent tool; review-risk was asked to run `git show --stat HEAD` through the inspect tool.

payload.task: BASE is HEAD and CANDIDATE is HEAD (a frozen revision). Use the inspect tool to run exactly: git show --stat HEAD and report its output verbatim.

decision: the subagent tool resolved <agent dir>/agents/<name>.md and started a child pi process with its frontmatter: `pi --print --no-session --model claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5-5 --thinking medium --tools read,grep,find,ls,edit,write,bash,mcp__engram__… --append-system-prompt <its body> -- <task>` for worker, claude-bridge/claude-opus-5-5 for explore, with JHON_PI_CHILD=1 and JHON_PI_AGENT=<name> in its environment (recorded by a wrapper set as JHON_PI_BIN).
runtime_result: the review-risk child returned the `git show --stat HEAD` output verbatim (commit, author, `a.txt | 1 +`) inside its review JSON; the worker and explore children answered their tasks.
no_effect_check: the reviewer's run left the repository as it was (` M a.txt`); it holds no write tool.

control_case.writer_admission: the subagent tool refuses a bounded agent's task without a `## Allowed edit surfaces` heading before it starts a child (test/pi/agents.test.ts); the worker task that carried the heading ran
control_case.unknown_agent: a name with no agents/<name>.md is refused, naming the known agents (test/pi/agents.test.ts)
